description: A consumption site whose iterator traces to no call floors, and the message says which problem it is: a parameter is unknowable from here, a `let` is a refinement not made yet. `returned-iterator-from-opaque-source` is the same rule on the producing side.

diagnostics.message: Consuming this iterator escapes this `@nothrow` function: nothing in the syntax names the call that produced it, so nothing can say whether consuming it throws. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this consumption with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
